title: Powder Brush
descriptionHtml:
What it is: A tapered dome powder brush with ultrasoft vegan bristles designed to effortlessly pick up any powder texture to blend, blur, or set makeup.

Brush Formulation: All Formulas

Brush Coverage: Buildable

Brush Handle Length: 6 inches

Bristle Type: Synthetic

Ingredient Callouts: It is vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Made with vegan fibers to easily pick up all powder formulas, the flexible, tapered dome tip delivers precision setting under the eyes. The ultra-soft, voluminous brush head diffuses bronzer, blush, or setting powder to cheeks and larger areas of the face for a flawless finish.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Dip brush into loose powder to set makeup under the eyes or across your face.
-Glide brush across powder blush or bronzer and blend into cheeks, forehead, or the bridge of the nose.
